facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog article 'How to leverage first-party data for programmatic advertising campaigns' was published on 2023-09-08.
The article states that three platforms are commonly used by marketers for first-party data storage: CRMs, CDPs, and DMPs.
facts.quote: There are three platforms that marketers commonly use for 1st-party data storage: CRMs, CDPs, and DMPs.

facts.fact: First-party data is defined in the article as information collected directly from customers and prospects, gathered from engaged, consenting users who are familiar with the brand.
facts.quote: [First-party data](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/1st-party-data) is information collected directly from customers and prospects. It is gathered from engaged, consenting users who are familiar with your brand and offering.

facts.fact: The article lists Salesforce and HubSpot as examples of CRM platforms.
facts.quote: Examples of CRMs include Salesforce and HubSpot.

facts.fact: The article lists Segment and Tealium as examples of customer data platforms (CDPs).
facts.quote: Examples of CDPs include Segment and Tealium.

facts.fact: The article lists Lotame, Adobe Audience Manager, and Oracle BlueKai as examples of data management platforms (DMPs).
facts.value: Lotame, Adobe Audience Manager, Oracle BlueKai
facts.quote: Examples of DMPs include Lotame, Adobe Audience Manager, and Oracle BlueKai.

facts.fact: According to the article, data integrity ensures the usability, accuracy, and consistency of an organization's data.
facts.quote: Data integrity ensures the usability, accuracy, and consistency of an organization's data.

facts.fact: According to the article, the main data integrity risks are human error, hardware and infrastructure failures, transfer errors, security issues, and cyber threats.
facts.quote: The main issues you should be aware of are human error, hardware and infrastructure failures, transfer errors, security issues, and cyber threats.
